Who We Are

Inspection With Integrity

GoXpert is a firm of registered Building Surveyors serving property owners across Malaysia. We inspect homes, commercial buildings and assets — and we report exactly what we find, whether it is convenient or not.

Most property owners face the developer or contractor alone, without the technical knowledge to argue their case. That imbalance is the reason this firm exists. Our surveyors are RISM-registered and hold degrees in Building Surveying, and our instruments are calibrated by SIRIM Malaysia — so what we report is measured, not assumed.

We do not carry out repairs and we do not take referral fees from contractors. Our only product is an honest, defensible assessment of your property's condition.

“If a defect is real, we will document it. If it is within tolerance, we will tell you that too.”

The standard we hold every inspector to
What We Stand For

Six Principles We Do Not Compromise

Always on the Client's Side

We are engaged by you and report to you — never to the developer or contractor

Measured, Not Assumed

Every claim in our report is backed by a reading, a photo or a recognised standard

We Do Not Sell Repairs

No repair work, no contractor commissions — nothing to gain from inflating findings

Plain Language

Technical enough for the tribunal, clear enough for a first-time homeowner

Honest About Tolerance

Not everything is a defect — we distinguish real issues from acceptable variation

We Finish What We Start

From the first inspection to re-inspection and tribunal support, if it comes to that
